section: Chorus 1 (same Slow Glide map + phrase leads)
note: Headphones required. A/B quickly — pick the one that externalizes best for YOU.

clips.title: MIT KEMAR (baseline)
clips.blurb: Current Slow Glide default. Dummy-head lab standard — start here.

clips.title: SADIE II D1
clips.blurb: York high-res dummy. Same map as KEMAR; usually subtle color shift.

clips.title: SADIE II H3
clips.blurb: York human subject H3. Often hard to tell from D1 on dense music.

clips.title: CIPIC subject 003
clips.blurb: Classic free human HRTF (UC Davis). Often a clearer color change than SADIE-H3.

clips.title: CIPIC subject 050
clips.blurb: Second CIPIC human — compare pinna fit vs 003.

clips.title: CIPIC subject 165
clips.blurb: Third CIPIC human for a quick ‘which ear fits me’ pass.

clips.title: ARI nh2 (Vienna)
clips.blurb: Austrian Academy free human set — different measurement chain from CIPIC/SADIE.

clips.title: Aachen high-res KEMAR
clips.blurb: Another free KEMAR measurement (dense grid). Compare vs MIT compact KEMAR.
